segments.contextAfter: An Accessibility Rotor is a shortcut for Accessibility users to quickly navigate to specific elements of the user interface, and optionally specific ranges of text within those elements.

segments.source: An Accessibility Rotor is a shortcut for Accessibility users to quickly navigate to specific elements of the user interface, and optionally specific ranges of text within those elements.

segments.contextBefore: Discussion
segments.contextAfter: In the following example, a Message application adds a Rotor allowing the user to navigate through all the ranges of text containing email addresses.

segments.contextBefore: An Accessibility Rotor is a shortcut for Accessibility users to quickly navigate to specific elements of the user interface, and optionally specific ranges of text within those elements.

segments.normalizedSource: ```swift extension Message { // Ranges of special areas in the `content` text. Calculated // when `content` is set and then cached so that we don't have // to re-compute them. var emailAddressRanges: [Range<String.Index>] } struct MessageContentView: View { TextEditor(.constant(message.content)) .accessibilityRotor("Email Addresses", textRanges: message.emailAddressRanges) } ```
segments.contextBefore: In the following example, a Message application adds a Rotor allowing the user to navigate through all the ranges of text containing email addresses.
